title: Battery-Operated Portable Power Tool Having a Motor Axis and a Working Axis

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.quote: A battery-operated grinder, in particular an angle grinder, includes an electronically commutated electric motor and a working shaft.
features.note: The reference describes a battery-operated handheld power tool, but it is a grinder, not a vacuum lifting device.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: The reference describes a grinding appliance and does not mention any suction cups or sealing lips.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: The reference describes an electric motor for a grinder, not a vacuum pump.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference does not mention any pressure sensors or monitoring of vacuum levels.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators related to vacuum levels.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning thresholds or vacuum levels.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or vacuum levels.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.quote: A rechargeable battery 50 is disposed on the second housing part 22. The rechargeable battery 50 serves to supply energy for the battery-operated grinding appliance 10.
features.note: The reference discloses a rechargeable battery integrated into the body of a power tool, but it powers a grinding appliance, not a vacuum pump.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: A battery-operated grinder, in particular an angle grinder, includes an electronically commutated electric motor and a working shaft.
features.note: The reference describes a battery-operated angle grinder, which is a type of single-hand portable power tool with all components carried by its body, without external hoses or cords.
features.refuted: The quote describes a battery-operated grinder with a motor and working shaft, but does not mention anything about a 'single-hand portable design' or the absence of 'external hose or cord'.

overall.why: The reference describes a battery-operated handheld power tool with an integrated battery, which aligns with some general aspects of the subject invention, but it is a grinder and lacks the core vacuum lifting mechanism and related features.
